Definition: from G4012 (in the sense of beyond); superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with G1537) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence:--exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly).
BiblicalUsage: Perissos means superabundant, more than enough. Paul says it is superfluous to write to the Corinthians about ministering to the saints, and Jesus says He came that we might have life, and have it more abundantly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the abundant life is not a little extra but life overflowing: Christ came that we might have it more abundantly, and I will not settle for less.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
